source: fussade.transpose on the medians of the Slovenian training table (si_full_train_czdef)

steps.label: Slovenian certificate
steps.note: Median delivered energy of the 4,054 certificates in this group, as issued under the Slovenian 2023 methodology, per m² of net conditioned area.

steps.label: − hot water (SI default)
steps.note: The Slovenian method books hot water at a default of 9 kWh/m²a of need over a system chain efficiency of 0.50: 18.0 kWh/m²a taken out to isolate space heating.

steps.label: − lighting (SI default)
steps.note: Residential lighting default in the Slovenian method: 7.1 kWh/m²a.

steps.label: heating, SI conditions
steps.note: What remains is space heating as delivered energy under Slovenian boundary conditions. Divided by the certificate's heating need it gives this building's own system efficiency (1/η = 1.48), which is carried over unchanged.

steps.label: × climate
steps.note: The Czech methodology uses one reference year (ČSN 73 0331-1, 3,506 degree-days) while Slovenian ones use the local climate (mean 2,802 degree-days across the register): heating need scales by 1.251.

steps.label: × ventilation
steps.note: Air-change rate 0.5 h⁻¹ in the Slovenian method against 0.3 h⁻¹ in the Czech one; only the ventilation share of the losses changes, which for this era of building gives 0.942.

steps.label: × indoor temperature
steps.note: Set-point 20 °C against 20 °C in the Czech zone definition: factor 1.000.

steps.label: + internal gains
steps.note: The Slovenian method assumes 4.14 W/m² of internal gains, the Czech one 2.75 W/m²: less free heat, so +8.2 kWh/m²a more delivered heating.

steps.label: × boiler defaults
steps.note: The two methods' default generator efficiencies differ for the boiler types typical of this era: factor 1.000.

steps.label: heating, CZ conditions
steps.note: Space heating as delivered energy under Czech boundary conditions and climate.

steps.label: + hot water (CZ default)
steps.note: Czech default hot water: 19.7 kWh/m²a of need over a chain efficiency of 0.70: 28.1 kWh/m²a.

steps.label: + lighting + auxiliary
steps.note: Czech residential lighting default 4.5 kWh/m²a plus 2 kWh/m²a of pump and control electricity, which the Czech definition counts inside delivered energy.

steps.label: × floor area basis
steps.note: Slovenian values are per m² of net conditioned area, Czech ones per m² of gross external area: ×0.85.

steps.label: in Czech definitions
steps.note: The value the model was trained to predict: the same building as the Czech methodology would describe it, derived from the two methodologies alone.
